newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen down Monday after rate rise.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen down Monday after rate rise.

text.p: Polish shares were seen falling on Monday after the central bank's interest-rate rise announced on Friday, but analysts said the move had largely been priced in by the market and that a rebound could soon follow.
On Monday the lombard rate goes up by two points to 27 percent and the discount rate by 2.5 points to 24.5 percent.
Analysts said Polifarb Wroclaw should fall on Monday after its suspension since July 11 due to flooding.
The firm, which trades on Monday without the 10-percent price fluctuation limit, suffered 11.6 million zlotys in damage and cut its 1997 net profit forecast by 10.2 percent.
Elektromontaz Warszawa transfers to the main market from the bourse's parallel floor on Monday.
